scope: Display simplification only. No model, circuit, runtime or scientific result change.
operator_rule: Iteratively prune whole terminal twigs shorter than the group threshold, measured along their 3D paths. Repeat until nothing changes. Preserve every root and explicit SWC soma, and ancestral paths. Simplify only remaining unbranched paths using original vertices.
budget_rule: Keep the stated highlighted thresholds fixed. If necessary increase only the interior threshold by 5 micrometres per step, logging every attempt. Select the first passing step. If budgets fail with root-only interior trees, stop and report.
coordinate_rule: Keep only original SWC vertices. No smoothing, resampling, invented soma, reconnection or interpolation. Quantization is a separate bounded transport approximation.
